what_happened.what: Completed FastAPI pinning service for delivery-kid: built config, auth, IPFS, transcoding, routes. Structure: Dockerfile, requirements.txt, app/ with config/auth/main, routes/ for health/albums, services/ for IPFS/transcode.
Updated delivery-kid ansible playbook to use new Python service instead of maybelle. Staged all changes, ready for commit.
Committed FastAPI service. User deployed maybelle and delivery-kid.
Created test-delivery-kid.py uptime monitor script for Jenkins. Tests health/version/time/IPFS/drift. Committed.

Added --rebuild flag to deploy scripts (deploy-delivery-kid-remote.py, deploy-delivery-kid.sh). Modified playbook to handle rebuild_images variable with docker compose --no-cache. Created delivery-kid-uptime.groovy Jenkins job.
Discovered old Node.js service still running (commit d354aba, not FastAPI c1a562e). User debugged: SSH to delivery-kid showed Node.js files still present (package.json, server.js), not Python files.
Root cause identified: 30 commits never pushed to origin/production before first deploy. Pushed to magent fork. User fetched/merged from there.

Removed IPFS/pinning service from maybelle entirely: deleted ~300 lines from maybelle.yml playbook (IPFS node tasks, pinning docker-compose), removed pinning/ipfs routes from Caddyfile template, removed authorized_wallets variables.
Verified FastAPI service now live on delivery-kid: health check shows IPFS connected, version endpoint returns correct commit (386a3fd). All test suite checks pass.
Ready for 4masks album upload. Provided URLs for upload page (cryptograss.live/tools/upload-album) and IPFS status endpoints on delivery-kid.

portrait: In this slice, magent was deeply focused on infrastructure delivery: completing the FastAPI pinning service for delivery-kid, debugging a deployment failure that revealed code never reached origin, and then optimizing maybelle by removing IPFS entirely once delivery-kid could handle the work. The work shows clear methodology (build → test → deploy → verify → cleanup) and pragmatism (when pushing from hunter failed, pushed to fork instead). Justin was a responsive collaborator, catching issues quickly and redirecting magent toward infrastructure hygiene. By day's end, the architecture had shifted from distributed pinning on maybelle+delivery-kid to a clean separation where delivery-kid owns IPFS pinning, maybelle focuses on orchestration, and the team was ready to upload the 4masks album that had been waiting nearly two years.
